title: O Primeiro Uniforme
summary: New Balance presents prototype Black, Blue, White, and Green uniforms while the partnership remains unsigned.
keyEvents: Black prototypes are intended for both main teams, Blue for League Academy Blue, White for League Academy White, and Green for Counter-Strike Academy.
All four prototypes use the same professional material standard.
New Balance requests a response by Friday, but Adrian has not signed.
